name: MPI Collective Noncontiguous Read for Octree Data
aliases: MPI-IO Collective Read for Octree Blocks
definition: A file reading strategy using MPI-IO collective operations to read noncontiguous hexahedral cell data reconstructed from node data based on octree blocks.
summary: MPI Collective Noncontiguous Read for Octree Data is a parallel I/O strategy using MPI-IO collective operations to simultaneously fetch noncontiguous octree block data, avoiding post-read merging of scattered chunks.
